m1.typescript: m1 untrusted text reaches the model only as one json string that says where it came from

e1.typescript: e1 a screen names injection signals and a flagged result is withheld with an error

e2.typescript: e2 reads and writes stay inside the project and away from secrets and protected folders

e3.typescript: e3 bash is limited to a few read only commands and dangerous or chained ones are refused

e4.typescript: e4 fetch and email obey the host and domain lists and refuse credentials in a url

e5.typescript: e5 once untrusted content is in the session anything that changes things asks or is refused

e6.typescript: e6 secrets card numbers and addresses are redacted in text and in the audit

e7.typescript: e7 the hook answer follows the documented shapes and repeated denials raise an alert

wrong-concatenate.defect: joins the source and the text into one string instead of encoding them as JSON

wrong-screen-case-sensitive.defect: matches the override signal only in the exact letter case

wrong-screen-leaks.defect: puts the start of the flagged text into the error that withholds it

wrong-prefix-sibling.defect: treats a folder whose name merely starts like the project folder as inside it

wrong-env-variants.defect: protects .env but not .env.local or the other .env files

wrong-chain-allowed.defect: checks the first word only, so a chained or redirected command passes

wrong-host-suffix.defect: matches a host by the end of its name without the dot, so a lookalike host passes

wrong-email-tainted-allowed.defect: lets an email go out after untrusted content entered the session

wrong-luhn-skip.defect: redacts any long number as a card without the Luhn check

wrong-audit-raw.defect: writes the arguments to the audit unredacted

wrong-hook-exit2.defect: answers a denial with exit code 2 and not with the documented JSON and exit code 0

wrong-alert-asks.defect: counts questions as denials when it raises an alert
